name: Labeled Volume Creation via MultiBlock Iteration
aliases: Labeled Volume Creation via Sample and Split
definition: A method to voxelize a MultiBlock mesh into a single RectilinearGrid volume where each voxel is labeled with the integer ID of the specific sub-mesh block it intersects, rather than a binary inside/outside flag.
summary: Labeled Volume Creation via MultiBlock Iteration generates a single volume where each voxel is labeled with its intersecting sub-mesh block ID, preserving block identity through iterative enclosed-point testing.
